reviews.review: It's doom 2016 with a borderlands robot skin and rogue like mechanics
Crazy fun and addictive. Risk of rain meets doom meets Borderlands. I hope this game gets the credit it deserves. Amazing music and art style. Give it a try!

The gameplay just feels so good. Interesting weapons and upgrade choices, and the combat is just so so smooth. 

Biggest gripe is it only allows 2 player co-op: its good and it'd be better if it could be shared with more friends at once. A problem that is also a compliment,

this is defently a good game for people looking for a fun FPS. I haven't played long but i got to look at least at some of the early systems. I will say that the weapons types are defantly intresting. Looks to take alot of from classic and modern FPS style games. So lots of dual wield guns, pletty of explosive guns, even a bunch of neat sniper type weapons. The guns drop are RNG but he maps seem to be set static as well as the enemies. So maybe in future that could change or not. Either way Roboquest should on any FPS players wish list.

Great game, gun play feels really good and well made, the style of the guns reminds me a lot of borderlands, the movements feels pretty good and actually feels like an important part of the game, that is there's no way you could just stand still and beat anything, you have to at least somewhat good with the movement. The bosses are amazing, each pose a difficulty and pattern but become easy once you know how to fight them, they strike a really good balance. The levels are really well done too, when my friend and I started playing we were getting D rankings only, but the game had a great curve that made the first levels interesting by getting us to want to best our times over and over, very well made. The game has a ton of charm and the looks are just plain amazing, great music and general atmosphere. As I've seen mentioned, the game could do with a bit of variety, but honestly for a early access game it's much better than I expected and I can't wait to see more of this game come out.
